adjudication.rationale: The finding misreads the code. The condition `if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === 'COLLECTIVE' && user.destinationCalendar)` at line 992 is inside a loop that processes team members to build `teamDestinationCalendars` array. If a user doesn't have a destinationCalendar, they simply don't contribute to this array - but this doesn't mean they won't receive a calendar event. The calendar event creation happens separately through `createAllCalendarEvents` which iterates over `evt.destinationCalendar`. The organizer's calendar is always included (lines 1053-1057), and the team destination calendars are pushed to the array (line 1068). Users without explicit destination calendars would still be attendees on the event. The finding incorrectly assumes this condition controls whether hosts receive calendar events, when it only controls which destination calendars are added to the array.
